whyThisMatters:
Tree Nerd Academy is the study set for the ISA Certified Arborist exam. More than six hours of video, more than 4,500 flashcards, and as many mock exams as you want. Finish the course, fail the first real attempt, and they say you can ask for a refund.

A practice test is free and needs no account. It's 100 questions in 105 minutes, across all 10 exam topics, with a score for each. Chris Comer teaches it. He's an ISA Board Certified Master Arborist with almost 20 years in the trade. The site says about one candidate in three fails the first try.

You pay once, and updates are included. It started in December 2025, in Sweden.
